title: Nine Rows of Finding
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（生活与学习·学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（生活与学习·学校生活）　|　核心词汇：classmate　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 classmate 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to find ① classmate she could not remember, and she said the finding was the whole of the lesson. The ② classmate, meaning the boy and not the friendship, was nine rows behind and was found by whoever came last; classmate, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ classmate in that school had the same desk, and the ④ classmate at the end, meaning the one the teacher kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever found properly. Classmate, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ classmate was the whole of the photograph, meaning the youth it carried and not the boy. The ⑥ classmate, meaning the youth and not any of that, is the only thing in a photograph that everybody looks for and nobody questions; classmate, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a boy and a youth. She said the youth is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ classmate had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the desk. The ⑧ classmate of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine rows and eleven years of finding; classmate, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ classmate I remember is the one at the end, which was found in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ classmate, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being found; every classmate, she said, is a youth that has agreed to look like a boy. She said the youth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 同学；同班同学
B. n. 同学（指那个男孩本身，与那份交情相对）
C. 固定搭配：find a classmate 找到一位同学
D. n. 同学（指那所学校里每一位）
E. n. 同学（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 少年时光（抽象：它承载的那段青春）
G. n. 那段青春（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The classmate, meaning the boy and not the friendship
classmate was the whole of the photograph
the classmate had become a number in a report
The classmate of the whole thing
A classmate, my grandmother said in 1972

answers.why: find a classmate 意为“找到一位同学”，1947 年母亲被派去找她记不起来的那位同学。
classmate 意为“同学、同班同学”，指那个男孩本身而不是那份交情，隔着九排，由最后来的人找到。
classmate 指那所学校里每一位同学，每一位都是同样的书桌。
classmate 指末尾那一位（老师留下的那一位），是唯一有人认真找过的。
classmate 意为“少年时光”，抽象指它承载的那段青春，父亲说 classmate 就是那张照片的全部。
classmate 为抽象用法，指那段青春本身，是一张照片里人人都找、却没人质疑的东西。
classmate 意为“同学、同班同学”，到 1962 年这位 classmate 成了报告里的一个数字。
classmate 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九排座位和十一年的寻找。
classmate 意为“同学”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1967 年找到，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
classmate 为抽象总称，祖母说一位同学是唯一会因为被认真寻找而变好的东西。
